layouts.name: Adelaide Parklands Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The organizer 2025 plan identifies the 14-corner Parklands circuit through Hutt Street, Flinders Street, East Terrace, Dequetteville Terrace and Victoria Park. The named independent circuit relation omits the Hutt/Flinders junction connection. Public way 567979078 supplies the existing joined source-node crossing at that same event-course junction, without interpolating a connector. That short connection is tagged cycleway in ordinary public traffic; the event closes this intersection for racing. The unchanged public-road centreline draft measures 3277.6 m against the catalogue scalar of 3225 m, and does not certify the temporary race-line or barrier alignment. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3277.6 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
